name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px inner #fff at 80% opacity. This ring is visible enough for keyboard users to track focus without overwhelming the interface, and the inner white edge prevents color blending with light backgrounds. The trade-off is slightly reduced contrast in dark themes, but the ring remains usable. This choice balances visibility, aesthetics, and accessibility standards.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring risks failing WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast in dark themes—test it at 100% opacity to confirm. A 2px ring with 2px inner white at 100% opacity meets contrast and avoids visual noise in dense layouts.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px inner #fff at 100% opacity. This meets WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast in dark themes while keeping the ring tight enough for dense layouts. The trade-off is a slightly thinner ring, but it’s still visible to keyboard users without overwhelming the interface.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring risks failing WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast on light backgrounds—#005fcc’s blue blends with white, making the inner white edge disappear. Test a 3px ring with a 1px inner #fff at 100% opacity; if contrast fails, switch to #003366 for the ring color—it meets contrast in both themes without visual noise.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt the 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px inner #fff at 100% opacity; if WCAG 2.2 contrast fails on light backgrounds, switch to #003366 for the ring color. Ramp owns the final CSS artifact and must deliver it with test results proving contrast passes in both light and dark themes.
